# WM Kanzlei AI Sanitizer

> WordPress plugin that replaces court file numbers, IBANs, e-mail addresses, 11-digit tax IDs, German phone numbers, names after a title or role and amounts in a text with placeholders (`{{TYPE_hex}}`) and puts the values back, through REST routes (`wm-kanzlei/v1`), WP-CLI (`wp kanzlei sanitize`) and a German admin simulator. It logs each call in an HMAC-chained table and sends nothing to AI providers.

## Overview

`wm-kanzlei-ai-sanitizer` is a WordPress plugin developed with an agentic workflow (AI coding agents). Detection is a set of regular expressions: names without a title, addresses, dates of birth, most ID numbers and health data are not detected. The placeholder mapping is returned to the caller and not stored; the result is pseudonymised text. The plugin does not assess whether a text may be given to a service provider under § 203 StGB, § 43e BRAO or the DSGVO, and it issues no certificates.

## Standards

- PHP 8.2+ with strict types
- No outbound requests, no assets from other hosts
- REST arguments declared; invalid UTF-8 refused; audit rows sealed with HMAC and verified
- Standalone test suite with a mutation check, PHPUnit unit tests
- Version 1.2.2.
